mostWorthwhile.text: Following iron from worn red cells to marrow making replacements was the most worthwhile part. It connected recycling to an ongoing body function.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the marrow to the body was less interesting than seeing how replacement worked; it mainly placed the process in the larger model.

surprise.text: I was surprised that iron from worn-out red cells could be recovered and used again to help make replacements.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and goals explained both renewal projects, though the offered menu supplied the compatible pairings.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: following a material through recycling and seeing it connected to the body was interesting, though some assembly steps felt predictable.
